sendFailed: Couldn’t send it (network error, or the page was refreshed in the meantime) — reload and try again.
sent: Sent to the bot — a few seconds.
notExecuted: The bot couldn’t carry it out
inProgress: The bot is working on it…
noPickup: The bot didn’t pick up the request — it’s probably not running or is restarting. It will carry it out as soon as it starts.
stillRunningText: The bot hasn’t finished yet — check on Discord, or try again later.
